headline: Dead Lands Bleed On as Fresh Fronts Flare Across the Map
war_summary: The twentieth day of the war shows no slackening at the front. In the Dead Lands the ledger has climbed to eleven thousand eight hundred sixty-nine Colonial and thirteen thousand five hundred ninety-eight Warden names since our last edition, with base activity logged as recently as mid-morning; seventeen events stand recorded across the day, chiefly at Liberation Point and Sun's Hollow, and the strongpoint count there holds at seven Wardens against four Colonials. Marban Hollow is the freshest field of action, its last entry filed only hours ago amid a five-to-three Colonial edge and a casualty toll climbing fast on both sides. Weathered Expanse reports enormous losses — seven thousand seven hundred forty-nine against seven thousand five hundred seven — with rates accelerating sharply, though not a single base movement appears in its record. Callahan's Passage likewise burns hot, warden losses outpacing colonial ones as enlistments surge. Endless Shore, yesterday's busiest field with forty-two events around Woodbind and Saltbrook Channel, has gone quiet since the small hours; Drowned Vale and Farranac Coast have also stilled. Rear provinces from Godcrofts to Westgate sit undisturbed behind undisputed colors, and thirty-four victory towns remain required before any victor may be declared.
